name: cps_loop_coherence_failure
description: Three-node monitoring cluster A_Sensor, B_Controller, C_Actuator with a triple monitoring overlap (2-simplex), plus D_Monitor. Three independent pairwise sensors at the A-B, B-C, A-C interfaces each report a residue of 1. These readings are mutually inconsistent: the cocycle condition delta^1 r = r_BC - r_AC + r_AB = 1-1+1 = 1 != 0 is violated at the triple overlap. The H^1 admissibility question does not arise.

diagnostic_claim.description: The root cause of the observed fault is the B_Controller subsystem.

observation_note: Three independent pairwise sensors at the A-B, B-C, and A-C interfaces each report a residue of 1. Transitivity requires r_AC = r_AB + r_BC = 2, but the A-C sensor reports 1. The sensor readings are mutually inconsistent.
